usedFor: Shopify holds the online orders and Ascora holds service jobs, so “Order Cancelled” can open a job through “Create Job”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Job” in Ascora
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is work someone should check, and the action puts it in Ascora as a job.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a job made from it appears after a scheduled check.
